purpose: Configure EIA US-average gas-price auto-polling, inspect its current status and equivalent price, and review historical prices.
primaryGoal: Inspect current prices and polling recency, run an immediate poll, and control automatic polling without losing historical context.

dataSources.behavior: Query key gas-price-status; enabled by default; cancellation signal forwarded; retry false; periodic INTERVALS.STANDARD refetch. Page derives DataState independently.
dataSources.contract: GasPriceStatus at web\src\api\types.ts:2021-2027: enabled, poll_interval, last_poll_time, current_price, current_price_kwh_eq.
dataSources.limits: Routes are conditional on opt.GasPriceWorker. Actual worker availability, source denomination/currency and runtime responses are unverified.

dataSources.behavior: Query key gas-price-history; cancellation signal forwarded; retry false; STALE_TIMES.STANDARD; safeArray select; no page date or vehicle filter. Chart reverses returned rows; table sorts its own copy.
dataSources.contract: GasPriceHistory at web\src\api\types.ts:2029-2037: id, price_per_unit, unit, efficiency_mpg, effective_from, effective_to, created_at.
dataSources.limits: Server ordering, completeness, mixed-unit history and price currency are not established by these frontend declarations.

operations.effect: Invalidates status and history; localized success/error toast.

dataSources.limits: No mutations were executed; worker scheduling, authorization and concurrent mutation behavior are unverified.

dataSources.endpoint: Not traced for this secondary source; only gas-specific hook endpoints were verified.
dataSources.behavior: Summary denomination uses saved gas_unit; currency display uses currency_symbol, decimal_precision and locale; chart resolves saved neon or color-blind-safe palette without resetting it.
dataSources.limits: Number/date utility internals, settings hydration and locale/timezone runtime behavior were not separately audited.

components.name: GasPriceAutoPollPage

components.name: GasPriceBrief / AdminSummary
components.contract: Four StatMetric occurrences; explicit source/scope explanations; initial loading; sourceStatus mapping; status-source retry and retained-data warning. Canonical OperationalBrief internals were not audited.

components.name: GasConfiguration
components.contract: DataState<GasPriceStatus>; explicit gas-auto-poll ID and help target; pending/no-data disabling; daily/7d/15d/30d interval choices; EIA source caption.

components.name: GasTrendChart
components.contract: DataState<GasPriceHistory[]>; compact fluid canonical frame; date/price rows and accessible dataColumns; loading/fatal/empty/retry props; palette-preserving area series.

components.name: GasHistoryTable
components.contract: Stable tableId admin:gas-price-history; row ID identity; five columns; four sortable fields; value filters; pagination; three-column mobile allow-list.

components.name: AdminSourceContent
components.contract: Fatal permission/auth-aware QueryError; loadingContent; retained data and retry; existing generic source adapter, not a new competing implementation.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Full-width min-w-0 container; forwards header/actions and independent dataSources. PageContainer:243-255 preserves children when no explicit loading/error/empty gate is passed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Status/history are queried once at page level and shared with two consumers each. State shells, chart framing, table pipeline, formatting and operational summary reuse existing owners; no confirmed competing local pipeline.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain existing owners and props; do not extract another state, chart, formatting or table implementation.

sourceStrategy: Page:69-74 uses single-column stack below xl; xl chart spans two of three columns with adjacent configuration.
Configuration:22 uses flex-wrap for toggle/status; chart uses ResponsiveContainer and compact fluid ChartCard.
History:56 keeps effective_from, price_per_unit and effective_to below md; shared DataTable:725 hides other columns.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 preserve full mobile details
issues.detail: mobileColumns excludes unit and efficiency_mpg; DataTable:715-725 hides excluded cells below md. Price includes unit, but efficiency has no caller-provided expanded detail or mobilePresentation alternative.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable mobilePresentation detail contract or existing expandable row detail to retain efficiency and all historical fields; keep tableId, ordering, filters and pagination.

sourceEvidence: Page:45 gives decorative action icon aria-hidden; Button owns action semantics and pending state.
GasPriceBrief:35 gives summary section a localized aria-label.
GasConfiguration:24-27 explicitly links gas-auto-poll toggle/help identity; Select:34-42 supplies localized label/help; status icons:30 are decorative with adjacent text.
GasTrendChart:21,24-26 supplies localized chart name and date/price table columns; shared ChartCard forwards these.
GasHistoryTable:35-51 provides localized column names and text/status labels.

issues.detail: Primary action explicitly uses size sm; actual target dimensions, shell composition and spacing exception are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Measure Poll now and configuration controls at narrow widths and 200% text; retain canonical Button and use its existing appropriate sizing if reachability is insufficient.

states.initialLoading: Brief forwards loading; configuration has two 64px skeletons; history has 240px skeleton; chart loading prop uses initial DataState.
states.empty: History DataTable and chart have explicit localized empty messages; brief uses unknown price values and Never/Awaiting first poll for the zero-time sentinel. Status payload absence is not replaced with fabricated values.
states.fatalError: Brief and configuration/table expose QueryError and retry; chart receives only fatalError and retry. Page source descriptors retain independently successful neighboring sections.
states.retainedError: deriveDataState retains bytes on refresh error or paused refresh. Brief renders StaleRefreshWarning; configuration/table render retained SourceContent message/retry.
states.mutationPending: Poll Button loading; toggle disabled during its mutation; interval disabled during its mutation or absent status. Hooks provide success/error toasts.
states.offline: Retained paused reads become stale. Initial paused reads remain initial with isRefreshBlocked; individual page consumers do not explicitly branch on this flag. Shared header notice behavior not fully traced.

issues.detail: Chart consumes loading/fatalError/empty but not source.status stale, isRefreshing, refreshError, isRefreshBlocked or updatedAt. History table retains a warning, and page-level dataSources may give general notice, but chart itself cannot explain retained price-series freshness.
issues.fix: Compose existing StaleRefreshWarning beside the chart or current SourceContent retained state; retain chart bytes, independent retry, dataColumns and frame. Do not turn refresh failure into fatal error.

visualIssues.detail: Chart has a hardcoded saturated amber fallback #f59e0b outside the canonical palette. Saved neon palette is deliberately supported by useChartPalette:18-21 and must not be reset. No explicit fixed-white, neon text, glow classes or raw controls were found in the five assigned page/domain source files.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical palette/token fallback; assess areaGradient intensity on actual themes without reducing data meaning or overriding explicit neon preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Both chart axes set fontSize 10 directly, bypassing shared typography preferences; actual readability and clipping are unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing chart typography tokens/preferences while retaining axes, tick currency formatting and compact chart geometry.

architectureIssues.detail: Header comment claims all sections live under ../components/gas-price and own their data states; actual imports use operationalbrief-a-g and continuation-admin-2, with page-owned queries.
architectureIssues.fix: Update only the stale architectural comment during assigned implementation; preserve current typed page/query ownership.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart maps history to date/price, dropping each row's unit and efficiency metadata. Table displays explicit source unit, but chart axis/dataColumns supply only saved-symbol currency. Whether returned history can mix denominations is unknown; no backend conversion guarantee was inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve source unit/currency guarantees with integration owner before changing measurements; retain raw values and surface existing row denomination in chart context/table/tooltip when needed. Do not invent FX or volume conversion.

priority.reason: Already uses canonical layouts, summary, chart, table and independent typed sources. Highest source-confirmed gap is hidden mobile efficiency; source trust, chart typography and denomination context need bounded follow-up.

competingImplementations.limits: Only direct gas-price consumers and bounded shared-owner API slices inspected. No evidence for a new shared component or an application-wide duplication claim.

actions.name: Sort effective date, price, unit and efficiency

dataBehavior: Retain status enabled/running versus stopped, current per-volume price, current per-kWh-equivalent price, and both relative/absolute last-poll text.
Retain zero-time sentinel Never/Awaiting first poll and current >0 price gating unless a separately verified domain correction authorizes change; unknown is not a measured zero.
Retain all history raw fields including source unit, efficiency_mpg, effective_from/effective_to, created_at and row ID; source-unit contract is not permission to guess SI conversion.
Retain ascending chart transformation of the returned order and independent descending initial table sort; backend order unknown.
Keep null effective_to as Current; missing cell text as em dash; preserve price/unit labels and localized efficiency labels.
Preserve currency precision/symbol, gas-unit and chart-palette preferences, source explanation, scope limits, responsive stacking and all pending/error/empty behavior.
Keep query keys, cancellation, retry/stale-time/refetch policies, toast feedback and exact mutation invalidations.
No page-specific chart export/fullscreen props are enabled; EmbeddedChart defaults these off. Do not claim new enabled capabilities or remove the shared chart data alternative.
Do not introduce workspace vehicle/date filters for these currently global status/config/history hooks without an actual server contract.
